issues.detail: The Greek verb 'παραδιδως' (paradidōs) means 'delivering up' or 'betraying.' The Vietnamese translation 'dùng cái hôn để phản' (using a kiss to betray) adds the specific method of a 'kiss' which is not present in this specific Greek text (though it is implied by context, the Greek text itself only says 'delivering up').
The Greek specifies 'τον υιον του ανθρωπου' (the Son of Man). While 'Con người' is used in Vietnamese, it lacks the specific 'Son of' (con) distinction present in the Greek.
